jobs.occupation: Senior TS/MS Specialist (m/f/d) - Pharma (Produktionsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Do you want to make a real difference in animal health? At Elanco, a global leader in animal health, we are driven by a passion to improve the lives of animals. Elanco Animal Health develops and markets innovative products and services to prevent and treat diseases in pets and livestock.

Become part of Lohmann Animal Health GmbH in Cuxhaven and join our dynamic team. As part of Elanco, we have been a world-leading specialist in the production of poultry vaccines for more than 50 years, exporting our products to over 70 countries worldwide. Expand your passion for animal health at Elanco – and join us as a Senior TS/MS Specialist (m/f/d).

As a Senior Specialist in TS/MS - Technical Services / Manufacturing Science – you are part of the scientific heart of production, serving as the vital bridge between Research & Development (R&D) and commercial manufacturing. Our team ensures that manufacturing processes are robust, validated, and state-of-the-art to guarantee a continuous supply of high-quality vaccines.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

TS/MS Project Management & Technical Leadership

- Lateral Leadership: Lead and inspire diverse cross-functional teams (Production, Quality Assurance, Engineering) to achieve project milestones through influence and collaboration.
- Process Scale-up: Drive the seamless transfer and scale-up of vaccine manufacturing processes from pilot to industrial level, ensuring deep alignment with GMP and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
- Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverage complex data analysis to optimize equipment utilization and strategic staffing requirements.
- Operational Excellence: Champion a continuous improvement mindset by implementing operational standards, managing critical deviations, and leading Root Cause Investigations (RCI) and CAPA processes.
- Risk & Compliance: Maintain the validated state of manufacturing processes and lead technical risk assessments (e.g., FMEA) to ensure robust business continuity and high-quality outcomes.
- Strategic Sourcing: Execute the technical implementation of secondary suppliers, ensuring full compliance with internal and external quality and regulatory requirements.

Collaboration and Communication

- Strategic Partnership: Act as a key technical consultant for cross-functional departments to develop and maintain scalable, cost-effective, and safe production processes.
- Audit Excellence: Represent the technical site functions during regulatory inspections and lead expert discussions with auditors.
- Technical Diplomacy: Synthesize complex technical challenges into clear, strategic updates for site leadership and global stakeholders.

YOUR PROFILE

Essential Qualifications

- Education: University degree (Master’s or equivalent) in Biology, Chemistry, Veterinary Medicine, Biotechnology, or a related life science discipline.
- Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in a pharmaceutical environment, specifically within pharmaceutical production.
- Compliance & Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Global Quality Standards (FDA, EU-GMP) and a solid understanding of aseptic processes.
- Languages: Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both German and English, with effective communication skills in multicultural settings.
- Analytical & IT Skills: Strong analytical capabilities and proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word); experience with statistical software (e.g., JMP) is highly desirable.

Desired Skills and Abilities

- Strategic Thinking: The ability to develop and implement long-term strategies aligned with business goals.
- Conflict Resolution: Effectively resolving conflicts and fostering a positive team environment.
- Change Management: Leading and managing change effectively within the team and across departments.
- Continuous Improvement Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying and implementing process improvements.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Effectively collaborating with other departments, such as Production units, R&D, Quality Assurance, and Supply Chain.
- Adaptability and Flexibility: Responding effectively to changing priorities and demands.
- Problem-Solving and Decision-Making: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and make sound decisions.

YOUR BENEFITS

- Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary package and participation in the company's success through our bonus scheme.
- Autonomy & Growth: Room for personal initiative and independent action within a modern, growing global pharmaceutical company.
- Career Development: Access to our internal global career network with exciting development and training opportunities.
- Dynamic Environment: Work in a diverse and interesting environment where your contribution directly impacts animal health worldwide.

jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Customs Specialist (m/f/d) (Speditionskaufmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Vestas Northern and Central Europe (NCE) is a sales business unit covering Scandinavia, the UK, Ireland, Poland, the Baltics, Germany and Benelux. The business unit is responsible for the full value chain of wind farm projects across these regions, including Sales, Project Execution, Installation, and Service.

Our ambition is to be the best performing business unit within Vestas while also making Vestas Northern and Central Europe the best place to work. We strive for excellence through collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

The department is characterized by an open and informal culture, where teamwork, strong communication, and mutual support are key to our success. Employees are offered the opportunity to work in a dynamic and fast paced industry, alongside a team of highly motivated and experienced professionals contributing to the delivery of sustainable energy solutions.

Responsibilities:

Customs within Vestas Northern and Central Europe (NCE) has the overall responsibility for ensuring a well functioning import and export setup that supports business operations across the NCE region at the lowest possible total cost, while fully complying with internal policies and external customs laws and regulations.

The role covers both strategic and operational customs activities and includes close collaboration with internal stakeholders, customs brokers, and external authorities.

Key responsibilities include:

- Addressing and supporting customs related topics in connection with new market entries and project setups
- Supporting, coordinating, and monitoring the customs broker operations across the NCE region
- Assisting Sales Business Units with customs related due diligence calculations and assessments
- Participating in the development of customs concepts, standards, and processes across regions with the objective of reducing overall operating costs
- Handling operational customs activities and day to day customs matters within the NCE region
- Preparing and supporting customs audits, including documentation and follow up actions
- Ensuring that all relevant stakeholders are proactively informed about customs matters and regulatory changes with potential compliance, cost, or operational impact

Qualifications:

- Experience from a customs compliance or customs operations function in an international business environment
- Hands on experience working with or within a Customs Broker organization, including coordination and oversight activities
- Formal training or education in Customs Compliance, International Trade, or a related field
- Solid understanding of international trade terminology and customs procedures
- Familiarity with import and export processes, customs documentation, and regulatory requirements
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders across functions and regions
- Strong oral and written communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered an advantage

Competencies:

- Ability to navigate, communicate, and collaborate effectively with customs authorities as well as with diverse internal stakeholders across functions and regions
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex customs topics in a clear and structured manner
- Capability to analyze, document, and outline processes, and to propose practical and sustainable implementation strategies
- A structured and solution oriented mindset, enabling effective handling of complex customs topics in a dynamic business environment

Your benefits - because your contribution counts:

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

jobs.description:
About us

Job description

In order to support the structures test department within airframe engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Control Systems Engineer for Structural Tests (d/f/m)

Are you interested to contribute to the testing of the very newest aircraft developments? With this position you have the chance to work both in the office and in the lab within a very international environment.

Empirical validation of aircraft design is a vital and mandatory step both in development and certification. Within the airframe organization, the structures test department is responsible for performing static and fatigue tests on all sizes of aircraft structure specimens. State-of-the-art methods are applied to control the load application and measure the response of the specimen.

In order to accelerate the aircraft development cycle, the improvement of test control technology and algorithms is a vital step. As a control systems engineer you will be able to explore and validate the latest developments in this field in collaboration with colleagues on all the European Airbus sites.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Setup of state of the art control systems based on commercially available technology.
- Installation and configuration of control systems for our test rigs.
- Enable fast test performance by optimisation of controllers.
- Creation of load profiles for static and fatigue tests.
- Management of subcontracted electrical installation activities .
- Ensurance of quality standards by securing and documenting the accuracy of load introduction
- Development of new control system solutions within transnational collaborations

Desired skills and qualifications

- University degree in engineering or science
- Good knowledge about control theory, signal processing and servo-hydraulic systems
- Several years of professional experience in setup of control systems (for example electrical installation, setup of computer networks and/or application of dedicated software solutions)
- Programming (any language)
- Open attitude towards working with various software packages
- Ability to work under time pressure without compromising quality of work
- Motivation to translate complex technical topics into understandable communication

jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Supply Market Intelligence (f/m/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

At Siemens Energy, we drive resilient and sustainable supply chains. As a Senior Expert in Supply Market Intelligence (f/m/d), you shape how Procurement understands supply markets, anticipates risks, and acts with foresight.
You combine a deep understanding of raw material markets in the energy sector, micro- and macroeconomic trends, with a structured, consulting-like approach—translating complexity into clear, actionable insights for the global Procurement community and key stakeholders.
You will monitor supply markets and act as a trusted advisor to Procurement (including senior leadership) and cross-functional stakeholders.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitoring and assessment of global supply markets, including raw materials, with identification of market risks, opportunities, and strategic scenarios to support business resilience and competitiveness
* Translation of market developments into actionable insights and business implications, enabling fact-based, data-driven decision-making across Procurement and the wider organization
* Continuous development and enhancement of the Supply Market Intelligence framework, including strategic scenario planning, market monitoring methodologies, and reporting dashboards
* Preparation and presentation of supply market intelligence to Procurement, senior management, and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring clear communication of key market developments and recommendations
* Leadership of strategic market intelligence initiatives and integration of market insights into procurement and supply chain strategies, processes, and decision-making combined with coordination of global cross-functional collaboration
* Implementation of digital, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of Supply Market Intelligence

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field
* Extensive professional experience in Supply Market Intelligence, Strategy, Procurement, Consulting, or related industries, preferably within energy, utilities, mining, or industrial manufacturing
* Strong analytical, strategic, and consulting capabilities, including structured problem-solving, hypothesis-driven thinking, and the translation of market insights into actionable business recommendations
* Proven project leadership and stakeholder management expertise, including ownership of cross-functional initiatives and effective engagement with senior management and international stakeholders
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence diverse audiences and foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and a strong one-team mindset
* Experience in digitalization, data analytics, and technology implementation within market intelligence or procurement environments, combined with fluency in English, international exposure, and willingness to travel internationally and domestically (approximately 10–20%)

About the Team

You will join a high-impact Supply Market Intelligence team within Corporate Procurement, shaping how Siemens Energy anticipates market developments and secures supply resilience. The team acts as a central intelligence and foresight hub, closely collaborating with the global Procurement community, Corporate Commodity Managers, and senior leadership to translate market complexity into actionable insights, strategic options, and measurable business impact.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead – Network Detection and Response Evaluation (m/f/d) (Cyber-Security-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19.6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87.000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide.

Job Description

As Project Lead for Network Detection & Response Evaluation, you will drive the selection and proof of concept validation of an Network Detection & Response solution and ensure it fits our Security Operations Center operating model and technical landscape. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, define success criteria, manage risks (e.g., performance, integration, compliance), and deliver a decision-ready recommendation including a roadmap from PoC to operational rollout.

Your tasks include the folliwing responsibilities:

- Leading the structured evaluation and selection of a Network Detection and Response solution, including requirements definition, vendor comparison, and decision preparation
- Planning and executing a proof of concept to validate detection capabilities, operational fit, and technical feasibility in a Security Operations Center environment
- Defining and aligning target use cases and success criteria for network-based threat detection and response, focusing on visibility gaps and anomaly detection
- Driving the integration concept into existing Security Operations Center tooling and processes, ensuring alignment with monitoring, investigation, and response workflows
- Coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across cyber security, infrastructure, and network domains to ensure alignment on architecture, data sources, and deployment approach
- Evaluating the reuse and integration of existing network telemetry and sensor data to optimize cost, complexity, and time-to-value
- Developing and documenting a target operating model for network-based threat detection and response within cyber security operations
- Identifying and managing key project risks, including performance impact, integration complexity, resource constraints, and data protection requirements
- Preparing management-ready recommendations, including solution comparison, risk assessment, and roadmap towards implementation and operationalization

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in a related field or comparable qualification
- Proven experience in leading cyber security or information technology projects on enterprise level, ideally in evaluation or implementation of detection and monitoring capabilities.
- Strong understanding of network-based threat detection and response principles, including behavioral analytics and anomaly detection approaches.
- Practical knowledge of enterprise network environments and data sources within large-scale enterprise environments, such as network flow data and traffic analysis approaches.
- Experience working with Security Operations Center environments and related platforms, including monitoring, alerting, and incident handling processes.
- Demonstrated ability to design and execute structured evaluation processes and proof of concepts with clear success criteria.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant recommendations.
- Solid understanding of compliance, governance, and data protection requirements in cyber security contexts
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)

Advantageous

- Experience in integrating detection and monitoring solutions into complex enterprise environments, including cross-domain architectures.
- Background in threat hunting, detection engineering, or incident response.
- Familiarity with network and endpoint security technologies and their interaction within a holistic security architecture.
- Experience in environments combining information technology and operational technology with specific monitoring requirements.
- Relevant certifications in project management or cyber security.

Additional Information

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

Job description

In order to support the A320 Family VSM (Value Stream Management) Industrial Evolution, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Internship within VSM Industrial Evolution (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Data Scientist (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the A320 Family VSM (Value Stream Management) Industrial Evolution as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: August 2026
- Duration: 3-6 months

JOIN THE TEAM THAT’S SHAPING THE FUTURE OF AIRCRAFT PRODUCTION!

Are you ready to take your next big step and dive into the world of industrial evolution? Look no further, because we’ve got the perfect opportunity for an intern at Airbus for an exclusive project!

We are a global team at the heart of the A320 Family production, and we’re on a mission to revolutionize how things are done. Specifically, we focus on the critical phase of fuselage assembly. You'll be helping us map out the future of aircraft production by integrating state-of-the-art measurement systems across our Final Assembly Lines (FALs). If you're a go-getter with a passion for precision, problem-solving, and working with a highly motivated team, you’re in the right place!

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Finkenwerder

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Get precise! You will dive deep into the world of measurement systems within our fuselage assembly, supporting the setup, testing, and evaluation of high-precision metrology tools.
- Crunch some numbers! You’ll collect, structure, analyze, and visualize measurement data that drives real change in how we align and join aircraft sections.
- Become a precision ninja! Help us optimize measurement concepts, evaluate tolerances, and ensure all fuselage components fit together like clockwork.
- Unleash your creativity! We want your input on automating data analysis and simplifying our measurement processes, so the fun stuff gets more focus.
- Show your skills! Present your findings in our weekly team meetings—you’ll be a key part of the conversation, not a coffee runner.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You’re enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in something awesome like Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metrology (Messtechnik), Industrial Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.
- Got some skills? If you’ve dabbled in 3D measurement technologies, laser tracking, CAD, or data analytics, that’s a massive plus!
- Languages! Fluent in English and German? Perfect! French? Even better!
- A proactive attitude and a talent for making sense of chaos—able to structure your work, handle highly precise data, and communicate results effectively.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Commercial in Bremen is looking for a

Supply Chain Quality Manager for Aircraft Wing Moveables (d/f/m)

The Supplier Chain Quality Management (SCQM) department acts as the primary operational interface with suppliers, driving end-to-end performance from initial assessment and selection during tendering through to serial production. Utilizing standard management tools, the team ensures on-time, on-quality delivery while governing compliance, quality approvals, and certification requirements. The department monitors new product introductions, transfers of work, and industrial qualifications to guarantee maturity before serialization. Additionally, the team evaluates supplier capacity, identifies industrial risks, and executes short-term recovery plans when disruptions occur. Finally, the department leads long-term supplier development and performance improvement projects while regularly reporting on operational metrics.

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

SCQM Accountabilities

- Strong collaboration with suppliers to ensure On Time and On Quality deliveries in order to deliver parts to all customers (FinalAssemblyLines and Plants).
- Work in partnership with suppliers to support their development.
- Ensure compliance of suppliers and products to applicable requirements with all relevant contributors.
- Contribute to the Supply Chain voice in the Multi-Functional Team (MFT) including program, engineering, customer services, buyer, etc.

Your Tasks

- Managing delivery recoveries / securing deliveries.
- Responsible for the surveillance of your supplier regarding process capability and product quality.
- Part of the supplier MFT and the supplier evaluation.
- Introduction and surveillance of Airbus Supplier standards.
- Handling of supplier disruptions.
- Proactive supplier improvement due to supplier projects.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- Minimum 3-year degree in Engineering or similar.
- At least 5 years of experience in manufacturing, quality, purchasing or supply chain.
- Technical Experience: Experience in metallic and composite assemblies.
- Project Management: Project management experience, specifically in performance or efficiency improvement projects.
- Quality & Methods: Experience with supplier surveillance, quality methods, and APQP knowledge.
- Fluent English is required; German and French language skills are a plus.
- Key Attributes: Stress resistance/resilience, good personal organization, collaborative mindset, and stakeholder management skills.
- Pluses: Assessor/Auditor skills.
- The job will require you to be able to travel frequently.

Are you stress resilient and keen to manage Delivery Crises and improve Quality? You want to extend your experience by managing workpackages at different Airbus Suppliers in Europe and across the globe? Your heart beats for aerostructure wing moveables? A Snapshot of Your Day 

You start your day aligning with project teams and the central S4E program on rollout progress and priorities. Throughout the day, you collaborate with colleagues from project management, sales, finance, and logistics to ensure smooth end-to-end processes. You represent business needs in discussions, review system changes, and support testing activities. You also guide users, clarify requirements, and contribute to change management efforts, ensuring that new SAP S/4HANA solutions are effectively adopted within GS C GCO.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Representation of business requirements as SAP Key User for Project Systems and Sales & Distribution across order-to-cash processes
* Planning, implementation, and execution of organizational change management activities during S/4HANA rollout phases
* Optimization of project structures, cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, execution, confirmations, and settlement processes
* Oversight of sales order management, pricing, delivery, and billing processes including integration with logistics and finance
* Execution and validation of functional testing activities including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing
* Ensuring correct integration between Project Systems, Sales & Distribution, and Finance within the S/4HANA environment

What You Bring

* Degree in business administration, information systems, engineering, or a comparable qualification
* Deep functional expertise in SAP Project Systems and SAP Sales & Distribution including lifecycle, controlling, order-to-cash, pricing, and billing
* Solid understanding of SAP integration concepts, particularly between Project Systems, Sales & Distribution, and Finance
* Experience in change management, business process ownership, or transformation projects as well as testing methodologies
* Strong analytical skills with ability to translate business requirements into system solutions and prior experience in training or coaching end users
* Good understanding of SAP Fiori and S/4HANA embedded analytics as well as fluent English language skills

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our team DDSF Digital Factory Team, Airbus Operations we are looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) to support the modeling of business process management (BPM) processes, IT conception, data & process mining

We are currently looking for a working student (d/f/m) specifically in the area of product life cycle management for activities related to process modeling, process mining, data mining, AI programming and project management.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.09.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Finkenwerder

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Recording of the AS-IS processes and the associated data flows for the production and engineering areas of the Airbus A320 electrical installations.
- Participation in the conception of IT projects.
- Participation in the analysis and optimization of processes (design, commissioning and production of electrical installations).
- Support in developing and testing the software.
- Design and update of project roadmaps and stakeholder maps.
- Support for individual digitization projects by creating reports and decision-making bases based on data and process mining (e.g. Skywise & Celonis & Google Suite & Klaxoon & ARIS).

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time (master's) student (d/f/m) in the field of business informatics, computer science, engineering or similar.
- Basic knowledge of business process modeling or willingness to acquire it.
- Google Suite knowledge and knowledge of a programming language of your choice (Python, Matlab, C).
- Initiative and analytical thinking.
- Motivation and team spirit as well as Hands-On & Can-Do Attitude.
- business fluent English skills.
- Programming & technology affinity.
- Experience with AIdevelopment platforms like Google GCP.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.
